denominator_definition: one unit per published confirmed leak (one corpus case), regardless of how many flaw sites or tool-specific scoreable sites it spans
attribution_rule_primary: leak detected iff production scoreCase output for that case contains a sample with actual=true and predicted=true (faithful regroup of the same run that produced the thesis's 15/50; includes the documented util.c::solv_replacebadutf8 naming-fallback artifact)
attribution_rule_sensitivity: leak detected iff a flagged finding's enclosing function explicitly matches a non-empty annotated flaw function under sameFunction semantics, with the Juliet contains('bad')/contains('good') naming fallback excluded (real-project corpus; fallback firing on solv_replacebadutf8 = 'replace bad utf8' manufactured 3 of variant-A's detections)
